Merge Fleet branch claude/fleet-retention into claude/new-session-2ibknw (after claude/fleet-fixes) and deploy: trips, stops, driving events and hourly/daily summaries older than 1 year are deleted for every client, for good (CNDP 17-2014)
details: First run: expected to delete close to nothing, because the data starts in August 2026; only records with a wrong tracker date would go. Not checked on the live database: the count query is in docs/OPERATIONS.md section 4.
Permanent: nothing in the app can bring deleted rows back. The only copy is the backup the deploy takes first; the deploy now stops if that backup fails.
Goes slightly beyond "trips, stops and summaries": driving events (harsh braking etc.) are also deleted after 1 year. One line to switch off if you want to keep them.
New: the backups taken before each deploy are deleted after 30 days (setting BACKUP_KEEP_DAYS on the server).
Users can no longer pick dates older than 1 year in trips, mileage, fuel, analytics and the trip/mileage/fuel/driving reports. A machine's work sessions stay open.

Wait for CI to pass first (it needs the GitHub billing fixed): the database part was not tested on the real database engine here. If it fails on the server, the site stays up on the old version and the deploy needs a manual retry.
Merge after claude/fleet-fixes: one import line in the reports form conflicts and is fixed at merge.
Tests: web 1666/1666, API 480 pass (database tests need CI), workers 852 and shared 965 pass; the 2 failing tests already failed before.
After the deploy: add a FAQ entry (draft in products/fleet/changelog.md) and update the privacy page with the sentence in docs/PUBLICATION-STORES.md.

summary: Fleet: other tables still keep vehicle locations with no time limit.
